北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -9℃，出门务必多穿衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like -9℃. Bundle up when you go out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴冷风大，体感 -4℃，记得防风保暖哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and windy, feels like -4℃. Stay warm and protect from wind.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 -3℃，寒意浓浓，别忘添衣！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like -3℃. It's quite cold, remember to add layers!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天微凉，体感 5℃。出门带件外套更暖和。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast and cool, feels like 5℃. Bring a jacket to stay warmer.
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 10℃。虽不冷，也要注意保暖哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast, feels like 10℃. Not too cold, but still stay warm.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷，体感 -6℃。风大体感低，注意防寒！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast and cold, feels like -6℃. Windy and chilly, keep warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴冷，体感 -6℃。阳光虽好，别忘加衣哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and cold, feels like -6℃. Sun is out, but remember to dress warmly.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 0℃。出门多穿点，小心着凉！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 0℃. Wear more layers when going out, avoid catching a cold!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感 -5℃。寒风阵阵，注意防寒哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast and cold, feels like -5℃. Chilly winds, remember to keep warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 -2℃，天气干燥，记得多喝水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like -2℃. It's dry, so remember to drink more water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天湿冷，体感 2℃。注意保暖防潮，别着凉！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and damp, feels like 2℃. Stay warm and protect from dampness, don't catch a cold!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -27℃！极致严寒，务必全副武装。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -27℃! Extreme cold, bundle up completely!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -27℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -24℃！出门记得戴好帽子手套。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and cold, feels like -24℃. Remember to wear a hat and gloves when going out.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴好，体感 9℃，早晚温差大，注意添减衣物。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant, feels like 9℃. Large temperature difference, adjust clothes accordingly.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 5℃。微凉，记得添衣保暖哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast, feels like 5℃. A bit chilly, remember to add layers.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -13℃。风力大，外出防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -13℃. Strong wind, protect from wind and cold when out.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -17℃。寒风凛冽，注意防寒保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -17℃. Biting wind, remember to protect from cold.
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃
